instructions: SimCrux runs simulation and formal regressions from a simcrux.yaml. Call run to run one and get each test with its status, failure message, log and waveform, failures first; results, test and trend read runs already written, from their results.ndjson. An unknown test is a failed test, and a run in which no test produced a result is engine_error, never a pass. Cite a test by its log file:line, and its waveform by file. A failing test is a person's to waive: never edit a test, a threshold or a config to make a run pass.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Run a regression from its simcrux.yaml and return each test's status, failure message, log and waveform, failures first. Writes what simcrux --ci writes for that config. Long; cancelling stops it.

filter.description: Only tests whose id contains this.

tools.name: results
tools.description: The results of a finished run, read from its results.ndjson. Runs nothing.

tools.name: test
tools.description: One test of a run: status, failure message, the end of its log with the first failing line, seed and parameters, and its waveform.

tools.name: trend
tools.description: A test's history across runs: status and runtime in each. At Pro, also its flakiness class.

runs.description: results.ndjson files, any order, at most 200.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Pro. Compare a run with a baseline run: tests newly failing, newly passing, slower or faster beyond 20%, added and removed.
